4:148: Ur Iḥemmel ara Ṛebbi nnaɛlat, siwa seg win iţwadensen. Ṛebbi Izga Issel, d Amusnaw.
4:149: Ma txedmem lxiṛ ɛinani, neɣ teffrem t, neɣ tsemmḥem abekkaḍu, Ṛebbi Izga Iţsemmiḥ, d Aḥernuk.
4:150: Ih, wid inekṛen Ṛebbi akked imazanen iS, u bɣan ad ssemfaṛqen Ṛebbi akked imazanen iS, qqaṛen: "numen s kra, nenkeṛ kra". Bɣan ad awin abrid garasen.
4:151: Widak, d ijehliyen n ṣṣeḥ. Nhegga, i ijehliyen, aɛaqeb isdullun
4:152: Wid iumnen s Ṛebbi akked imazanen iS, ur ten ssemgarraden, widak, deqqal a ten id ias warraz nnsen. Ṛebbi Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
4:153: La k d ssuturen, At Tezmamt, ad asen d tesserseḍ Tazmamt seg igenni. Niɣ ssutren, i Musa, sennig waya. Nnan as: "ssenɛat aɣ d Ṛebbi, a T nwali". Tebbwi ten ssiɛqa, ilmend n ddens nnsen. Sinna, ɛabden aɛjmi, mbaɛd ma iusa ten id ubeggen. Nesemmeḥ asen aya. Nefka, i Musa, adabu n ṣṣeḥ.
4:154: Nessuli adrar sennig sen, ilmend n laɛqed nnsen. Nenna yasen: "kecmet si tebburt s lekni". Nenna yasen: "ur txalafet ssebt". Neṭṭef segsen laɛqed iṣeḥḥan.
4:155: Imi neqḍen laɛqed nnsen, u nekṛen issekniyen n Ṛebbi, u nɣan lambiyya, war ssebba, u nnan: "ulawen nneɣ duben". Xaṭi, d Ṛebbi iten Iselɣen, ilmend n tjehli nnsen. Drus kan i iumnen.
4:156: Ilmend n nnekṛ nnsen, u gren d, ɣef Meryem, acehrir abarar;
4:157: u nnan: "nekwni nenɣa Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem, Amazan n Ṛebbi". Ur t nɣin, ur t semmṛen ɣef umidag. D lexyal kan ger wallen nnsen. Ih, wid imgarraden fellas, atnan di ccekk fellas, ur ẓṛin fellas acemma, teddun kan d nnwaya. Metbut, ur t nnɣin.
4:158: Xaṭi! Issuli t Ṛebbi ɣuṛeS. Ṛebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
4:159: Ur illi yiwen, seg wAt Tezmamt, ur numin yis, uqbel tameţţant is. Ass n tnekra ad yili d anagi nnsen.
4:160: Ilmend n ddens n wudayen, Negdel asen tiẓidanin i illan ḥellent asen, imi daɣen, ṭṭeṛṛifen aṭas seg ubrid n Ṛebbi;
4:161: u ssexdamen rrba, i illan teţwakkes asen, u teţţen ayla n medden, d aḥerfi. Nhegga d, i ijehliyen segsen, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
4:162: Maca, wid, segsen, izaden di tmusni, lmumnin iumnen s wayen ik ed irsen, akked wayen id irsen, uqbel ik, wid ibedden i tẓallit, wid iţzekkin, wid iumnen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru, widak, ad asen Nefk arraz ameqwṛaḥan.
4:163: Ih, Nweḥḥa yak ed, akken Nweḥḥa i Nuḥ, akked lambiyya deffir es. Nweḥḥa i Ibṛahim, Ismaɛil, Isḥaq, Iaɛqub, laɛṛac, Ɛisa, Yub, Yunes, Harun, Sliman. Nefka Ihellilen i Dawed.
4:164: Akked lambiyya iɣef ik ed Neḥka, uqbel; akked lambiyya, iɣef ur ak ed Neḥki. S tideţ, Immeslay Ṛebbi i Musa.
4:165: Lambiyya iţbecciṛen, inedṛen, iwakken ur ţnamaren medden ɣef Ṛebbi, deffir imazanen. Ṛebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
4:166: Maca, Icuhhed Ṛebbi ɣef wayen ik ed Issers, s tmusni S. Ad cehhdent lmalayek. Nesteqnaɛ s Ṛebbi d Anagi.
4:167: Ih, wid ijehlen, u ṭṭeṛṛifen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi, niɣ nnetlafen ttelfan uɣmiq.
4:168: Ih, wid ijehlen u densen, ur sen Iţsemmiḥ Ṛebbi, ur ten Iţţawi d ubrid,
4:169: siwa abrid n Loahennama, degs ad wekkṛen, i lebda. Ayagi, Izga d ayen isehlen i Ṛebbi.
4:170: A yimdanen! Niɣ iusa kwen id Umazan, s tideţ, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen. Amnet, ţţif i kunwi. Ma tugim, ihi n Ṛebbi, i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Ṛebbi Izga Iẓṛa, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
4:171: A yAt Tezmamt! Ur sfuhruyet ddin nnwen. Ur qqaret, ɣef Ṛebbi, siwa tideţ. Lmasiḥ Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem, d amazan kan n Ṛebbi; d awal iS i Irra ar Meryem, u d ṛṛuḥ s ɣuṛeS. Ihi, amnet s Ṛebbi akked imazanen iS, ur qqaṛet: "kraḍ"! Ḥebset, ţţif i kunwi. Ṛebbi d Yiwen kan n Ṛebbi. Gedha s yiS, ma ad Isɛu mmi S! IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Nesteqnaɛ s Ṛebbi d Awkil.
4:172: Ur ismummi ara lmasiḥ, ma illa d amdan n Ṛebbi. Akken lmalayek tuqṛibin. Wid ismummin a T ɛabden, u zuxxen, ad ţwafessren akw ɣuṛeS.
4:173: Wanag wid iumnen, u xedmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Ifk arraz nnsen, ad asen Irnu si lfeḍl iS. Ma d wid ismummin u zuxxen, a ten Iɛaqeb aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan. Ur ţţafen, war Ṛebbi, bab neɣ asettaṛ.
4:174: A yimdanen! Niɣ iusa kwen id utebbet sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, u Nessers awen ed tafat ibanen.
4:175: Wanag wid iumnen s Ṛebbi, i iṭṭfen degS, a ten Issekcem ar uḥunu S akked lfeḍl. A ten Inhu ɣuṛeS, deg ubrid uwqim.
4:176: Cawṛen k. Ini: "Ṛebbi Isfehm awen d ɣef llzem. Ma immut urgaz, war tarwa, isɛa taultmaţ, i neţţat azgen n wayen id iooa. Neţţa a ţ iwṛet, ma ur tesɛi tarwa. Ma snat ay llant, amur wis kraḍ i yal ta, n wayen id iooa. Ma llan watmaten akked tessetmatin, i uqcic amur n snat n tullas". Ibeggen awen d Ṛebbi akken ur teţnnetlafem. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa yal cci.
5:1: A wid iumnen! Eṭṭfet deg iɛahden nnwen. Ḥellen awen lmal n tejlibt, kkes ed wid i wen nnan. Ur awen tḥell ara ṣṣyada, mara tḥuoem. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţţameṛ ayen i S ihwan.
5:2: A wid iumnen! Ur ssiṛxiset isekkiren n Ṛebbi, aggur iṛqan, ṭḥegga, snaoeq, wid iteddun ar Uxxam n Lḥaṛam, saramen lfeḍl akked llza n Mass nnsen. Ṣegdet mi tfukkem. Xas tcuḥnem agdud i wen igedlen Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam, ur iwata ara a ţzegrem tilas. Mɛawanet ar yiseɣ akked uḥezzeb, ur ţţemɛawanet ar ubekkaḍ akked lbeɣwḍ. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. S tideţ, Ṛebbi Iwɛaṛ deg uɛaqeb.
5:3: I wen iţwagedlen d loifa, idim, aksum n yilef, wayen iţwamezlen i war Ṛebbi, ayen iţţuxenqen, ayen i ţwaṣerɛan, ayen igrarben, ayen iţţuberrzen, ayen ičča lweḥc - siwa ma tessawḍem tezlam t -, ṭḥegga i tezṛa, aseqdec n tseqqaṛt. Ayagi d ucmit. Assa, wid ijehlen uysen si ddin nnwen. Ur ten ţţagwadet, agwadet iyI. Assa, Nnekmaleɣ awen ddin nnwen, Tameɣ awen lɣit iW, Ṛuḍaɣ awen annuz d ddin. Win terra tmara di tegwniţ n llaẓ, ur iffiɣ abrid, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
5:4: A k steqsayen acu i sen iḥellen. Ini: "iḥell awen wayen imaɛnen. Ayen d teţţawin s lewḥuc iţṣeggiden. Tesḥefḍem asen ayen i wen Isseḥfeḍ Ṛebbi. Eččet seg wayen i wen d ṭṭfen, mmektit ed fellas isem n Ṛebbi". Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţɣawal deg uqeṭṭi.
5:5: Assa, iḥell awen wayen imaɛnen. Iḥell awen lqut n wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, - iḥell asen lqut nnwen -; tilawin tiḥuṛiyin iumnen, tilawin tiḥuṛiyin seg wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, ma tefkam asent tuččit nnsent; d uwqimen mačči d ucmiten, ur teţţeddum d temddukwal. Win iugin liman, mḥan igiten is. Neţţa, di laxeṛt, seg imexsuṛen.
5:6: A wid iumnen! Ma tekkrem ar tẓallit, ssirdet udmawen nnwen, ifassen nnwen alamma d tiɣwmaṛ, sɛaddit ifassen illexsen ɣef iqweṛṛa nnwen, ssirdet iḍaṛen nnwen ar twelza. Ma tellam s loanaba, zzizdget. Ma tuḍnem neɣ tunagem, neɣ iusa d yiwen segwen si ccicma, neɣ tennulem tilawin, ur tufim aman, ddmet akal zeddigen, sɛaddit eţ ɣef udmawen nnwen akked ifassen nnwen. Ur Ibɣa ara Ṛebbi a kwen Iqelleq, maca Ibɣa a kwen Izzizdeg, ad awen Itim lɣit iS, amar a ţesnemmrem.
5:7: Mmektit ed lɣit ikwen Iɣat Ṛebbi, akked nnesba ikwen Inuseb, mi tennam: "nesla u nunez". Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Issen i illan deg idmaren.
5:8: A wid iumnen! Illit d ṛṛsem ar Ṛebbi, d inagan at lmizan. Ur kwen issencaf ddɣel n ugdud, ur twezznem. Wezznet. Lmizan iqṛeb aṭas ar uḥezzeb. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Issen ayen txeddmem.
5:9: Iɛahed Ṛebbi ssmaḥ akked warraz ameqwṛaḥan, i wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan.
5:10: Wid ijehlen u skaddben issekniyen nneɣ, widak d at ujajiḥ.
5:11: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed lɣit ikwen Iɣat Ṛebbi, amek agdud iţheggi iman is, ad isɛaddi afus is fellawen. Iṭṭef akin ifassen nnsen, segwen. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. ɣef Ṛebbi ara ţţeklen lmumnin.
5:12: Niɣ Irra Ṛebbi laɛqed i At Isṛail. Nessuffeɣ ed, segsen, mrawsin imḍebbṛen. Inna Ṛebbi: "Nek yidwen ma tẓullem, tzekkam, tumnem s imazanen iW, u tɛawnem ten, tṛeḍlem i Ṛebbi aṛeṭṭal igerzen. War ccekk, ad awen Kkseɣ tucmitin nnwen, a kwen Skecmeɣ di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen. Win ijehlen segwen, deffir waya, niɣ innetlaf seg ubrid umɛin".
5:13: Imi ooan laɛqed nnsen, Nexza ten, Nesgursel ulawen nnsen. Ssexsaṛen inumak n wawalen, ţţun amur n wayen iɣef ţwafekkṛen. Mazal a d temlileḍ d lexdaɛ nnsen, siwa drus segsen. Semmeḥ asen u ssuref. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iḥemmel iɛaṛḍiyen.
5:14: Wid iqqaṛen: "nekwni d imasiḥiyen", Nerra laɛqed yidsen, ţţun amur n wayen iɣef ţwafekkṛen. Nessker ed, garasen, taɛdawt akked ddɣel, ar ass n tnekra. Deqqal a ten Ixebbeṛ Ṛebbi ɣef wayen la ṣenɛan.
5:15: A yAt Tezmamt! Niɣ iusa kwen id Umazan nneɣ. Ad awen ibeggen aṭas n wayen la teţţeffrem, n Tezmamt. Ad Iţsemmiḥ i waṭas. Niɣ tusa kwen id tafat sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, akked Tezmamt iţbegginen.
5:16: Inehhu yis Ṛebbi, ar iberdan n tifrat, wid iṛeɣben llza S. A ten Issuffeɣ si tillas ar tafat, s tsriḥ iS. A ten Inhu s abrid uwqim.
5:17: Niɣ jehlen wid innan: "Ṛebbi, s tideţ, d lmasiḥ, mmi s n Meryem". Ini: "anwa isɛan kra n lkwelf, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ma ihwa yaS ad Ineɣ lmasiḥ, mmi s n Meryem, imma s, akked wayen akw illan di tmurt"? N Ṛebbi tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
5:18: Udayen akked imasiḥiyen, nnan: "nekwni d tarwa n Ṛebbi, d wid Ismenyaf". Ini: "acimi, ihi, ikwen Iţɛaqab ɣef ibekkaḍen nnwen? Xaṭi, kunwi d imexlaq am wiyaḍ". Ad Isemmeḥ i win i S ihwan, ad Iɛaqeb win i S ihwan. N Ṛebbi tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Taggara ɣuṛeS.
5:19: A yAt Tezmamt! Niɣ iusa kwen id Umazan nneɣ, ad awen ibeggen, mi tɛadda tallit war imazanen. Akka ur d teqqaṛem ara: "ur aɣ d iusi ubeccaṛ, neɣ uneddaṛ". Ihi, iusa kwen id ubeccaṛ, uneddaṛ. Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
5:20: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Mmektit ed lɣit ikwen Iɣat Ṛebbi. Irra segwen lambiyya, Irra kwen d igeldan. Ifka yawen ayen ur Ifki i yiwen, deg imaḍalen.
5:21: A yagdud iw! Kecmet akal iṛqan, i wen Iura Ṛebbi. Ur d ţţuɣalet ɣer deffir wen, a d tegwrim txesṛem".
5:22: Nnan: "a Musa! Degs agdud iɛafriten, nekwni ur ţ nkeččem, d awezɣi, alamma ffɣen d segs. Mi d ffɣen segs, a nekcem".
5:23: Sin irgazen, seg wid iugaden - Isɛad iten Ṛebbi -, nnan: "kecmet ɣuṛsen si tebburt; ma tkecmem, kunwi, ih, a ţrebḥem. Pţeklet af Ṛebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
5:24: Nnan: "a Musa! Nekwni ur ţ nkeččem, d awezɣi, skud mazal iten degs. Ṛuḥ, kečč d Mass ik, nnaɣet. Nekwni a neqqim dagi".
5:25: Inna: "a Mass iw! Ay melkeɣ, nek, siwa iman iw akked gma; ihi, Semfaṛeq aɣ d ugdud".
5:26: Inna: "ihi, tamurt agi teţwagdel asen. Ukuẓet iseggwasen ad menṭaṛen di lberr. Ur ɣwebben ɣef ugdud iballaɣen".
5:27: Eḥku yasen, s tideţ, taqṣit n sin warrac n Adem, mi ṭḥeggan i sin. Sɣuṛ yiwen teţwaqbel. Sɣuṛ wayeḍ ur teţwaqbel ara. Inna: "war ccekk, a k nɣeɣ". Inna: "Iqebbel kan Ṛebbi ṭḥegga sɣuṛ wid iţḥezziben.
5:28: Ma ibbweḍ iyi d ufus ik, ad iyi tenɣeḍ, nek, ur k id iţţaweḍ ufus iw, a k nɣeɣ. Nek, ţţagwadeɣ Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen.
5:29: Nek, bɣiɣ a ţţawiḍ abekkaḍ iw, akked ubekkaḍ ik, a ţţiliḍ seg wat tmes. Winna d aqeṭṭi imednas".
5:30: Iaɛzem, deg iman is, ad ineɣ gma s, dɣa inɣa t. Igwra d seg imexsuṛen.
5:31: Iuzen ed Ṛebbi tagerfa, tkeṛṛeḍ akal, iwakken ad as tessenɛat amek ara iɣumm loeţţa n gma s. Inna: "a ssexḍ iw! Ur bbwiḍeɣ ad iliɣ am tgerfa yagi, ad ɣummeɣ loeţţa n gma". Igwra d seg wid inedmen.
5:32: Ilmend n waya, Nura i At Isṛail, ar win inɣan amdan ur nenɣi yiwen, ur nessefsed di tmurt, amzun inɣa imdanen meṛṛa. Win issadren yiwen, amzun issader imdanen meṛṛa. Niɣ usan ten id imazanen nneɣ, s ubeggen. Sinna, deffir waya, s tideţ, aṭas degsen ssuguten di tmurt.
5:33: Aqeṭṭi n wid iţnaɣen Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, u ssenkaren asefsed di tmurt, siwa timenɣiwt, neɣ asemmeṛ ɣef umidag, neɣ anegzum ufus sya, uḍaṛ sya, neɣ anfay si tmurt. Ayagi, d aqeṭṭi nnsen di ddunit. Di laxeṛt, fellasen aɛaqeb ameqwṛaḥan.
5:34: Kkes ed wid inedmen, uqbel a ţḍebbṛem fellasen. Cfut ar Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
5:35: A wid iumnen! Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, nadit a ţqeṛṛbem ɣuṛeS, nnaɣet deg ubrid iS, amar a ţrebḥem.
5:36: Ih, wid ijehlen, xas ad sɛun i illan akw di tmurt, rnu yas win i t icban, iwakken ad fdun, yis, iman nnsen seg uɛaqeb, ass n tnekra, ur iţwaqbal segsen. Fellasen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
5:37: Ad bɣun a d ffɣen si tmes, ur llin d wid id iteffɣen. Fellasen aɛaqeb imezgi.
5:38: Amakwar, tamakwart, gezmet asen ifassen nnsen, d aqeṭṭi n wayen xedmen, d aɛaqeb sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
5:39: Win inedmen, deffir ddens is, u iuɣal d aɛṛḍi, ad as Issuref Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
5:40: Day ur teẓṛiḍ ara n Ṛebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan? Iţɛaqab win i S ihwan, Iţsemmiḥ i win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
5:41: A Nnbi! Ur k ɣweblen wid iţɣawalen ar tijehli, seg wid iqqaṛen numen, s imawen nnsen, ur uminen wulawen nnsen, seg wudayen issemḥasen i tikerkas, issemḥasen i ugdud nniḍen, ur d nusi ɣuṛek. Pbeddilen awalen deffir ussefhem nnsen. Qqaṛen: "ma iţţunefk awen d waya, ddemt eţ; ma ur awen d iţţunefk ara, ɣuṛwat"! Win Ibɣa Ṛebbi a t Ihewwel, ur t teţsellikeḍ, s wacemma, seg ufus n Ṛebbi. Widak, d wid iwumi ur Ibɣa ara Ṛebbi, ad izdigen wulawen nnsen. Di ddunit ad ţwaxzun. Di laxeṛt fellasen aɛaqeb abarar.
5:42: Wid issemḥasen i tikerkas, iteţţen leḥṛam, ma usan k id, fru garasen, neɣ eoo iten. Ma teooiḍ ten, ur k ṭṭuṛṛun s wacemma. Ma tḥuddeḍ, ḥudd garasen s lmizan. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iḥemmel wid iweznen.
5:43: Amek ara k id asen, s aḥuddu, u nitni sɛan Tuṛa, degs aḥuddu n Ṛebbi? Sinna, deffir waya, ad wexxṛen. Ur llin wigi si lmumnin.
5:44: Ih, Nessers ed Tuṛa, degs nnhaya akked tafat, ferrun yis ger wudayen, lambiyya imḍuɛen. U iṛabaniyen akked lecyux seg wayen jemɛen, si Tezmamt n Ṛebbi, u llan d inagan is. Ur ţţagwadet imdanen, agwadet iyI. Ur d ţţaɣet, s issekniyen iW, ayen ṛxisen. Wid ur neţḥuddu yara s wayen id Issers Ṛebbi, widak d ijehliyen.
5:45: Nura yasen degs: ṛṛuḥ s ṛṛuḥ, tiṭ s tiṭ, anzaren s wanzaren, ameẓẓuɣ s umeẓẓuɣ, tuɣmest s tuɣmest, leoruḥ ad ţţuḥesben. Win iooan, d leɣṛama s. Wid ur neţḥuddu yara s wayen id Issers Ṛebbi, widak d imednas.
5:46: Nuzen ed, deffir sen, Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem, a d itebbet ayen it id izwaren di Tuṛa. Nefka yas Linoil, degs nnhaya akked tafat, a d itebbet ayen it id izwaren di Tuṛa. D nnhaya u d anabi i wid iţḥezziben.
5:47: At Linoil, iwata ad ḥudden s wayen id Issers, degs, Ṛebbi. Wid ur nḥudd ara s wayen id Issers Ṛebbi, widak d iballaɣen.
5:48: Nessers ak d Tazmamt, s tideţ, a d tebbet ayen iţ id izwaren n Tezmamt. Nḍemn iţ. Ihi, ḥudd garasen s wayen id Issers Ṛebbi. Ur teddu d lhawiyyat nnsen, beṛṛa n wayen i k id iusan n tideţ. I yal wa, Nefka lqanun akked ubrid. Lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, yili Irra kwen d yiwen n lois. Maca, iwakken a kwen Ijeṛṛeb ɣef wayen i wen Ifka, mzizlet ar lxiṛ. Ar Ṛebbi tuɣalin nnwen akw. A kwen Ixebbeṛ ɣef wayen tellam temgarradem.
5:49: Ḥudd garasen s wayen id Issers Ṛebbi. Ur teddu d lhawiyyat nnsen. ɣuṛek a k hewwlen ɣef kra seg wayen i k d Issers Ṛebbi. Ma wexxṛen, ẓeṛ ar Ṛebbi Ibɣa kan a ten Iwwet ɣef kra ibekkaḍen nnsen. Ih, aṭas n medden d iballaɣen.
5:50: Day bɣan aḥuddu n zzman n war tussna? Anwa yifen Ṛebbi d Amḥaddi, i ugdud ineṣḥen liman?
5:51: A wid iumnen! Ur ţţarat, d iḥbiben, udayen akked imasiḥiyen. Garasen d iḥbiben. Win, segwen, i ten irran d iḥbiben, ad yili segsen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
5:52: A ţwaliḍ imuḍan n wul, ţţazzalen ɣuṛsen, qqaṛen asen: "nugad ay d itezzin fellaɣ". Ahat a d Ias Ṛebbi s lɣelb, neɣ s lameṛ sɣuṛeS. A d gwrin di nndama, ɣef wayen ffren deg iman nnsen.
5:53: A d inin wid iumnen: "day d wigi i iggullen s Ṛebbi, tagallit meqqwṛen, ar nitni llan yidwen"? Mḥan igiten nnsen, gwran d d imexsuṛen.
5:54: A wid iumnen! Win segwen iooan ddin is…, ihi, deqqal Ṛebbi a d Iawi agdud Iḥemmel, i T iḥemmlen; ad ṛaḍin lmumnin, ad qesḥen ar ijehliyen. Ad nnaɣen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Ur ţţagwaden alummu n win iţlummun. Ayagi d lfeḍl n Ṛebbi, Iţţak it i win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
5:55: Imawlan nnwen siwa Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, wid iumnen, wid iţẓallan, ţzekkin, u nitni ṭṭinizen.
5:56: Wid irran d imawlan nnsen, Ṛebbi, Amazan iS, akked wid iumnen…, ih, akabar n Ṛebbi, d nitni ara irebḥen.
5:57: A wid iumnen! Ur ţţarat d iḥbiben wid id ilhan, di ddin nnwen, s wurar d utihi, seg wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, akw seg ijehliyen. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
5:58: Ma teddnem i tẓallit, fellas ad mmaɛlken, ad uraren. Ayagi, acku nitni d agdud ur nefhim.
5:59: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acu iɣef la ɣ ttehmem, siwa imi numen s Ṛebbi, akked wayen id Issers ɣuṛneɣ, akked wayen id Issers uqbel? Tegwti degwen d iballaɣen".
5:60: Ini: "ad awen mleɣ aqeṭṭi n Ṛebbi icemten sennig wagi? Wid Ixza Ṛebbi, sserfan T, Irra ten d iddawen, d ilfawen". Ɛabden iṛebbiten n tkerkas. Widak, atnan di liḥala tucmiţ maḍi, di ttelfan uɣmiq seg ubrid uṣwib.
5:61: Mi d usan ɣuṛwen, qqaṛen: "numen". Niɣ kecmen d s tijehli, u nitni ffɣen yis. Ṛebbi Yif akw akken Issen, ayen teffren.
5:62: La teţwaliḍ aṭas, degsen, ţɣawalen ar ubekkaḍ akked wanfal, teţţen leḥṛam. I icmet wayen xeddmen!
5:63: A lemmer i sen kksen iṛabiyen akked lecyax, awal ubekkaḍ akked wučči n leḥṛam? I icmet wayen la ṣenɛen!
5:64: Qqaṛen wudayen: "iskkweṛ ufus n Ṛebbi". D ifassen nnsen i isekkwṛen. Pwaxzan ilmend n wayen d qqaṛen. Xaṭi! Ifassen iS llin, Iţɣiti akken i S ihwa. Ayen i k d irsen, sɣuṛ Mass ik, war ccekk, irennu i waṭas segsen, lebɣweḍ akked tijehli. Nessker garasen cceḥna, akked ddɣel, ar ass n tnekra. Yal tikelt ara caɛlen times i ṭṛad, a ţ Issexsi Ṛebbi. Pnadin asefsed di tmurt. Ṛebbi ur Iḥemmel ara ifessaden.
5:65: At Tezmamt, lemmer day umnen u ḥezzben, yili, war ccekk, Nekkes asen tucmitin nnsen, u Nesskecm iten ar leonanat isaɛdiyen.
5:66: Lemmer day ṭṭifen di Tuṛa akked Linoil, akked wayen i sen d irsen sɣuṛ Mass nnsen, war ccekk, ad ččen sennig sen, akw seddaw iḍaṛen nnsen. Illa garasen lois iṛeznen. Aṭas, degsen, dirit wayen xeddmen.
5:67: A yAmazan, mel ayen i k d irsen, sɣuṛ Mass ik. Ma ur t temliḍ ara, ur tessawḍeḍ ara tabraţ iS. Ṛebbi a k Ifukk si lɣaci. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.
5:68: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Ur tellim deg wacemma, alamma teddam d Tuṛa, Linoil, akked wayen i wen d irsen, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen". Ayen i k d irsen sɣuṛ Mass ik, war ccekk, irennu, i waṭas segsen, lebɣweḍ akked tijehli. Ur ɣwebbel ɣef ugdud ijehliyen.
5:69: Ih, wid iumnen, udayen, iṣabiyen, imasiḥiyen, wid iumnen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ţţagwaden, ur ɣweblen.
5:70: Niɣ Nga laɛqed i At Isṛail, Nuzen asen imazanen. Yal tikelt ara ten id ias umazan s wayen ur asen nehwi, wa a t skiddben, wa a t nɣen.
5:71: ɣilen ur iţţili uhewwel. Dreɣlen, ɛaẓgen. Sinna, Issuref asen Ṛebbi. Sinna, aṭas degsen dreɣlen, ɛaẓgen. Ṛebbi Iţwali acu xeddmen.
5:72: Niɣ jehlen wid iqqaṛen: "Ṛebbi, s tideţ, d lmasiḥ, mmi s n Meryem". U inna lmasiḥ: "a yAt Isṛail! Ɛabdet Ṛebbi, Mass iw, d Mass nnwen". Ih, win icerken i Ṛebbi, Igdel as Ṛebbi Loennet. Axxam is d times. Ur llin isellaken i imednas.
5:73: Niɣ jehlen wid iqqaṛen: "Ih, Ṛebbi d wis kraḍ n kraḍ". Ur illi ṛebbi siwa Ṛebbi Yiwen. Ma ur xḍin ara i wayen qqaṛen, war ccekk, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan ad iḥaz wid ijehlen segsen.
5:74: Day ur tuben ara ar Ṛebbi, u ssuturen aS ssmaḥ? Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
5:75: Lmasiḥ, mmi s n Meryem, d amazan kan. Niɣ ɛaddan, uqbel is, imazanen. Imma s tessawal tideţ. Llan teţţen lqut. Wali amek i asen Neţbeggin issekniyen; sinna, wali amek la ţţagwin.
5:76: Ini: "day a ţţaɛbdem, war Ṛebbi, ayen ur nezmir a kwen iḍuṛṛ, neɣ a kwen infaɛ"? Ṛebbi, Neţţa, Issel, d Amusnaw.
5:77: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Ur rennut, di ddin nnwen, ayen ur nelli d tideţ. Ur teddut d lemcihwat n ugdud innetlafen zik, i itelfen aṭas, u telfen seg ubrid uṣwib.
5:78: Pwaxzan wid ijehlen, seg wAt Isṛail, sɣuṛ iles n Dawed akked Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem; ayagi, ɣef wayen ɛuṣan, u zgaren tilas.
5:79: Ur ţţemyekkasen ayen xedmen n dir. I icmet wayen xeddmen!
5:80: A ţwaliḍ aṭas segsen, ad xalḍen wid ijehlen. War ccekk, icmet wayen xedmen i iman nnsen. Ad Izɛaf Ṛebbi fellasen. Nitni ad wekkṛen deg uɛaqeb.
5:81: Lemmer uminen s Ṛebbi, Nnbi, akked wayen i sen d irsen, ur ten ţţaran d iḥbiben. Maca aṭas, segsen, d iballaɣen.
